card.line: Zoar was a small city near Sodom, also called Bela. God spared it so Lot had a safe place to run when Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed.

moments.title: Lot Eyes the Plain
moments.text: Lot looks out and sees the whole plain of the Jordan, all the way to Zoar, well watered like the garden of the LORD. He chooses it for himself.

moments.title: Kings Go to War
moments.text: Zoar, called Bela, has its own king. He joins the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim in rebelling against Chedorlaomer and gathering for battle.

moments.title: A Town Spared for Lot
moments.text: Lot asks to flee to a nearby town, and the town is not destroyed. He is told to hurry there, and that is why it is called Zoar. Lot reaches it at sunrise.

moments.title: Lot Leaves Zoar
moments.text: After Sodom and Gomorrah are destroyed, Lot is afraid to stay in Zoar. He and his two daughters leave and settle in a cave in the mountains.

moments.title: Moses Sees the Land
moments.text: From the mountain, the LORD shows Moses the land promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. It reaches from the Valley of Jericho all the way to Zoar.
